questions.question: Vijayanagara was founded in 1336 on the Tungabhadra by which two Sangama brothers?
questions.rationale: Harihara I and Bukka I of the Sangama family founded the city in 1336; tradition says the sage Vidyaranya guided their reconversion and the state's founding.

questions.question: The Bahmani sultanate was founded in 1347 by:
questions.rationale: Ala-ud-din Hasan Bahman Shah, known as Hasan Gangu, broke from Delhi in 1347 and ruled from Gulbarga (Ahsanabad).

questions.question: Abdur Razzaq, who described Vijayanagara as a city 'such that the eye has not seen', came as envoy from:
options: Shah Rukh of Herat in Persia
questions.rationale: Abdur Razzaq was Timurid Shah Rukh's envoy from Herat; he visited Deva Raya II's court in 1443 and wrote his account in the Matla-us-Sadain.

questions.question: Krishnadevaraya's famous Telugu work on devotion and kingship is:
questions.rationale: Krishnadevaraya himself composed the Amuktamalyada in Telugu, containing a celebrated chapter of statecraft; Manucharitamu was by his court poet Allasani Peddana.

questions.question: The Raichur battle of 1520, witnessed by Domingo Paes, ended in victory for Krishnadevaraya over:
questions.rationale: At Raichur in 1520 Krishnadevaraya crushed Ismail Adil Shah's army — the Portuguese visitor Domingo Paes watched the fight and praised Hampi as the best-provided city in the world.

questions.question: The battle of Talikota (Rakshasa-Tangadi) in 1565 was fought against an alliance of:
options: The Bahmani kingdom and the Mughals
questions.rationale: The Deccan sultanates of Bijapur, Ahmadnagar, and Golconda united, destroyed Rama Raya's army, beheaded him, and sacked Hampi — ending Vijayanagara's greatness.

questions.question: Mahmud Gawan's administrative reform increased the Bahmani provinces (tarafs) from four to:
questions.rationale: Gawan reorganised the kingdom into eight tarafs, enlarged crown lands, and moved nobles to cash salaries — reforms that provoked the Deccani faction into forging the letter that cost him his life in 1481.

questions.question: The Bahmani capital was shifted from Gulbarga to Bidar by:
questions.rationale: Ahmad Shah Wali (1422-1436) moved the capital to Bidar around 1424 and conducted devastating campaigns against Vijayanagara and Warangal.

questions.question: Under the nayankara system of Vijayanagara, military chiefs held revenue assignments of land known as:
questions.rationale: Nayakas held amaram — revenue assignments — on condition of maintaining troops for the raya; iqta was the Sultanate's parallel institution and brahmadeya a Chola land grant.

questions.question: The famous stone chariot and halls of musical pillars belong to which temple at Hampi?
questions.rationale: The Vitthala temple, expanded under Krishnadevaraya, houses the stone chariot and pillared halls whose columns sound musical notes; Hazara Rama was the royal chapel with Ramayana friezes.
